sideA.text: Draw and read the other side of this card.

sideB.text:
DESTROY THE FOLLOWING OBJECTIVES:
• RECON EAST ASIA
• CONNECT 2 NEW CITIES
• COMPLETE 2 SEARCHES

A new mandatory objective is enclosed. We need to complete 2 objectives this month.

Chart, with no further caption on the card:
SEPTEMBER: 3 stars, 12
OCTOBER: 2 stars, 8
NOVEMBER: 1 star, 4

Open the following doors:
P    37

mechanics.whenRead: Continue the October setup Legacy-deck reading, immediately after 10-02. Side A says to read side B now.
rules: Destroy the objectives RECON EAST ASIA, CONNECT 2 NEW CITIES, and COMPLETE 2 SEARCHES.
A new mandatory objective is enclosed (10-04, the next card).
The card prints a three-column chart: September shows 3 stars and 12, October shows 2 stars and 8, November shows 1 star and 4. The card does not label what the stars or the numbers stand for.
mechanics.notes: P and 37 are in separate white boxes with red type. P is a letter. October's 2 stars line up with the "2 objectives this month" sentence, and September and November show 3 and 1 stars. The numbers under the stars are 12, 8, and 4. What is inside doors P and 37 is not printed on this card.
